text: The Cyclone Reinsurance Pool Strata Mitigation Discounts initiative is a strategic enhancement to Australia's cyclone risk management framework. Administered by the Australian Reinsurance Pool Corporation, it introduces discounts within the premium pricing model for strata properties that implement specific cyclone risk reduction measures. This initiative aims to financially incentivize resilience investments by aligning insurance pricing with actual reduced risk, thereby encouraging strata schemes to undertake practical risk mitigation activities.
